checks.title: Ensure SSH server prefers protocol 2
checks.rationale: SSH protocol 1 has known cryptographic flaws.

checks.title: Ensure root login over SSH is restricted
checks.rationale: Direct root login via SSH increases attack impact.

checks.title: Ensure UFW firewall is active
checks.rationale: Host firewall provides defense in depth.

checks.title: Ensure auditd service is active
checks.rationale: Audit logging supports forensic analysis and intrusion detection.
checks.remediation: Install auditd and enable the service.

checks.title: Ensure /etc/passwd exists
checks.rationale: Baseline filesystem sanity check.
checks.remediation: Investigate filesystem integrity if this fails.

checks.title: Ensure /etc/shadow has no empty password fields
checks.rationale: Accounts with empty passwords allow trivial login.
checks.remediation: Set strong passwords or lock accounts with passwd -l.

checks.title: Ensure SSH MaxAuthTries is 4 or fewer
checks.rationale: Fewer auth attempts per connection slows online brute force.

checks.title: Ensure SSH PermitEmptyPasswords is disabled
checks.rationale: Empty-password logins must never be accepted over SSH.

checks.title: Ensure SSH X11 forwarding is disabled
checks.rationale: X11 forwarding exposes the client X server to the remote host.

checks.title: Ensure SSH idle timeout (ClientAliveInterval) is configured
checks.rationale: Idle sessions should be terminated to limit hijacking of unattended terminals.

checks.title: Ensure SSH LoginGraceTime is 60 seconds or less
checks.rationale: A short grace time limits the window for unauthenticated connections.

checks.title: Ensure SSH does not offer CBC ciphers
checks.rationale: CBC-mode ciphers are vulnerable to known plaintext-recovery attacks.
checks.remediation: Restrict 'Ciphers' to AEAD/CTR suites (e.g., chacha20-poly1305, aes256-gcm).

checks.title: Ensure SSH does not offer weak MAC algorithms
checks.rationale: MD5 and 96-bit truncated MACs are cryptographically weak.
checks.remediation: Restrict 'MACs' to ETM SHA-2 variants (e.g., hmac-sha2-256-etm).

checks.title: Ensure an SSH warning banner is configured
checks.rationale: A pre-auth banner provides legal notice.

checks.title: Ensure IP forwarding is disabled
checks.rationale: A host that is not a router should not forward packets.
checks.remediation: Set net.ipv4.ip_forward=0 in /etc/sysctl.conf and run sysctl -p.

checks.title: Ensure ICMP redirects are not accepted
checks.rationale: Accepting ICMP redirects allows route table tampering.

checks.title: Ensure source-routed packets are not accepted
checks.rationale: Source routing can be used to bypass network controls.

checks.title: Ensure reverse path filtering is enabled
checks.rationale: RP filtering drops spoofed source addresses.

checks.title: Ensure TCP SYN cookies are enabled
checks.rationale: SYN cookies mitigate SYN-flood denial of service.

checks.title: Ensure suspicious packets (martians) are logged
checks.rationale: Logging martian packets aids detection of spoofing/misconfig.

checks.title: Ensure ASLR (address space layout randomization) is enabled
checks.rationale: Full ASLR makes memory-corruption exploits significantly harder.

checks.title: Ensure ptrace scope is restricted
checks.rationale: Restricting ptrace limits process memory inspection between users.

checks.title: Ensure time synchronization is active
checks.command: systemctl is-active systemd-timesyncd 2>/dev/null || systemctl is-active chrony 2>/dev/null || systemctl is-active ntp 2>/dev/null
checks.rationale: Accurate time is required for log correlation and certificate validation.

checks.title: Ensure unattended security upgrades are installed
checks.rationale: Automatic security updates reduce exposure window for known CVEs.
checks.remediation: apt-get install unattended-upgrades and enable it via dpkg-reconfigure.

checks.title: Ensure password maximum age is 365 days or fewer
checks.rationale: Bounding password age limits the lifetime of a compromised credential.
checks.remediation: Set PASS_MAX_DAYS to 365 or fewer in /etc/login.defs.

checks.title: Ensure password minimum length is 14 or more
checks.rationale: Longer minimum length materially increases brute-force resistance.
